newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SPORTING WIN TO STAY ON COURSE FOR EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPORTING WIN TO STAY ON COURSE FOR EUROPE.

text.p: Sporting beat Braga 1-0 at home on Saturday to boost their chances of qualifying for the European Champions Cup next season.
With reigning league champions Porto steaming towards their third successive title, Sporting and Lisbon city rivals Benfica are battling for second spot and a place in Europe's top cup competition.
Sporting extended their advantage to eight points over Benfica, who were held 1-1 away to Boavista, with just eight more games to play.
Porto maintained their 10-point lead at the top of the table with a 2-1 away win over Farense on Friday.
Sporting should have scored after 16 minutes when they were awarded a penalty. But captain Oceano Cruz failed with the penalty kick.
The home side finally went ahead after 54 minutes when substitute Jose Dominguez beat two defenders before sending a fierce shot just inside the right post.
Benfica went one goal down after just five minutes when a shot from outside the area by Bolivian international Edwin Sanchez took a deflection and beat Michel Preud'homme in the Benfica goal.
Benfica only managed to equalise through newly-signed Brazilian striker Valdir Moraes in injury time.
Porto also had a substitute to thank for their victory over Farense. Brazilian striker Artur Oliveira scored twice after coming on in the second half.
Porto have 66 pontos, ahead of Sporting on 56 and Benfica on 48.
